items.title: How Airbnb uses cost per task to operate coding agents on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Airbnb runs evals on real engineering tasks and uses Amazon Bedrock observability to choose models for its coding agents and control production costs. This post shows how cost per task guides model selection, why production spending can differ from eval results, and how to monitor latency, manage quotas, and attribute spend.
items.creator: Alan Yao
